title: Magic Product Review RANT -Pen Through Coin By Michael Ammar
description:
Pen through Coin is a classic of magic and this one is an updated version by the legend Michael Ammar and released through Penguin Magic. While I love the effect and gimmicks provided I had a real problem with the tutorial. Watch the review to get the details and my perspective on this release. 
If you are interested in purchasing Pen Through Coin By Michael Ammar you can get it at PenginMagic.com
